title: Doodles (DOOD) Will Be Available on Binance Alpha and Binance Futures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Doodles (DOOD)  will open for trading on  Binance Alpha  and   DOODUSDT  Perpetual Contract  will be available on  Binance Futures  with up to 50x leverage on  2025-05-09.  The exact trading time will be announced on  2025-05-09 .  Binance is the first platform to announce the listing of  Doodles (DOOD)  on Alpha and Futures trading. To celebrate the launch, users who meet the  Binance Alpha Points  threshold will receive their DOOD airdrop within 10 minutes after trading starts. The threshold will be announced on  2025-05-09 .  Starting from 2025-05-13, Binance will introduce an Alpha Points consumption mechanism. With this mechanism, the system will deduct a certain amount of Alpha Points when the user successfully participates in a Token Generation Event (TGE) or claims an airdrop. Stay tuned for further updates!  About Doodles: Doodles is a community-driven storytelling brand bringing art, music, and animation on chain.  Please Note:   The DOOD airdrop is not included in Alpha Points consumption mechanism.  The aforementioned perpetual contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Futures and spot token listings are  not correlated . A token listed on Binance Futures  does not guarantee  that it will be listed on Binance Spot. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-05-07
